reviews.rationale: Independent work supports sensitivity to irrelevant context, but re-analysis challenges the breadth of GSM-Symbolic effects and reconstructed NoOp results depend strongly on item ambiguity. Robustness of the other cited planning, multiplication, and chess findings remains unchecked; the packet does not establish that all cited results fail.

contract.note: The named study supplies the relevant model, task, and size comparison. Restricting the claim to contemporaneous o1-preview results is fair.

evidence.note: The study reports 97.8% accuracy on 3–5-block problems and 23.63% on 6–20-block problems, directly establishing both parts of the claim.
Improvement over earlier models concerns a different comparison. It is compatible with the reported within-model decline as problem size increases.

reviews.rationale: The cited contemporaneous study directly documents strong small-problem performance and a steep decline on larger Blocksworld instances. Its acknowledgment of substantial progress over earlier models does not contradict this size-related decline.
